prompt: The phase-selection function may change. The source says the queue model represents that function. What should an engineer do with this link?

options.text: Review the model assumptions that depend on phase selection.
options.feedback: The directed link identifies a concrete model to inspect. The engineer can then establish and record the effect of the proposed change.

options.text: Mark the signal interface as failed.
options.feedback: The link records what the model represents. A failure claim requires an observed result against a criterion.
The views draw on maintained definitions. Checking the shared definition first shows which views actually need updating.

prompt: An assistant suggests an interface ID that is missing from the source graph. How should the engineer record it?

options.text: Connect it to the nearest-looking interface name.
options.feedback: A similar label provides no evidence of identity. That guessed connection would mislead the next review.

options.text: Remove the question because the graph has no edge.
options.feedback: A missing edge can identify a gap in the recorded information. Other sources may still show an effect.

options.text: Keep it as an unresolved review question and check its source.
options.feedback: The uncertainty stays visible and reviewable. A verified identity can later support a recorded relationship.
